lore.cold_sweat.thermometer: A tool that displays the exact world temperature when held. Crafted with gold and flux.
lore.cold_sweat.thermolith: A flux component that outputs a signal based on the current ambient temperature. 0 is freezing, 15 is burning.
lore.cold_sweat.hearth: A furnace-like block that warms the space around it when fuelled with fuel, or cools it when fed Ice. Keeps you comfortable through harsh weather.
lore.cold_sweat.hearth_bottom: A furnace-like block that warms the space around it when fuelled with fuel, or cools it when fed Ice. Keeps you comfortable through harsh weather.
lore.cold_sweat.filled_waterskin: A leather skin full of water. Drink it to cool down, or warm it on a fire first to heat up.
